title: Poll in the timeline
summary: Shows a poll as a card in the chat: the question, the options, the person's own choice, the votes when visible, and an end button for the person who started it.

votes.description: Number of voters. Shown only when results are visible.

isWinner.description: After the end: has the most votes (ties all win).

options.description: In the order of the poll.

resultsVisible.description: Disclosed polls always; Undisclosed after the end.

isEnded.description: The poll has an end time.

canEnd.description: The person started the poll and it is open.

vote.effect: Single choice: replaces the vote. Multiple: toggles the option, up to maxSelections. Timeline.sendPollResponse with the poll event id and all chosen ids. Does nothing after the end.

end.effect: After a confirm: Timeline.endPoll with the poll event id and bipe_app_groups_poll_end_text as the fallback text for other apps.

notes: The SDK gives the poll as MsgLikeKind Poll (question, kind, max selections, answers, votes per answer, end time). The votes map is answer id to voter IDs.
bipe_app_groups_poll_votes takes the voter count formatted by the system.

A poll is end-to-end encrypted like the rest of the group (product.json polls). Votes are room events, so every member's app can see who voted for what; Undisclosed only hides the counts on screen until the end.
Open polls the person has not answered appear in the what-you-missed block (group-quiet).
